description:
Find your dream car in Romania using everyday language. Skip the complex filters and search forms. With Autovit, simply describe what you're looking for - "SUV with low mileage, great for family of 4" or "recent model, city car."

Key features:

1. Advanced Search: Describe your ideal car in natural language
2. Relevant results: Get matches for your search
3. Interactive refinement: Ask follow-up questions to narrow your search 

Whether you're a first-time buyer or seasoned car enthusiast, Autovit makes car buying as simple as having a conversation.

defaultPrompt: Show me an automatic car below 50K EUR
